Signature-based IDs preserve identities when overloads are inserted or reordered, but change when the signature changes. Positional IDs preserve a signature edit’s slot, but renumber declarations on insertion.

A stateless snapshot cannot guarantee both while giving overloads distinct IDs. I’ll keep the finding open; resolving this needs a decision about identity semantics rather than another switch between those two implementations.
